sentence: This project supports tumor research by using imaging methods to collect tissue samples during surgery and to link imaging features to genes.
This project builds optical imaging tools that overcome tissue scattering to make 3D images of how tissue takes shape in developing embryos.
This project develops antivirals that target a viral helicase to treat viral diseases, including those caused by Zika virus.
This project builds a modular system that makes Cas9-based editors work in mice to edit the genome and epigenome.
This project collects data across sites and provides reproducible bioinformatics workflows and computational modeling tools.
This project tests in a randomized controlled trial whether a machine-learning tool that predicts postpartum hemorrhage risk in real time helps patients.
This project tries to find genes that are needed for the early development of the mammalian cochlea and the organ of Corti.
This project compares statistical approaches for analyzing smart phone data to understand substance use patterns in daily life.
This project studies how congenital disorders of glycosylation harm neurons, using human cortical organoids made from patient stem cells.
This project studies how branched-chain amino acid metabolism in macrophages weakens the immune response against pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
This project builds peptide antivirals that stop the virus from entering the host cell and resist degradation.
This project uses neuroimaging of amyloidosis, tauopathy and neurodegeneration to support research on Alzheimer's disease.
This project studies how proteins change in cells with genomic imbalance, using mass spectrometry.
This project tests whether removing one gene helps macrophages clear apoptotic cells and slows atherosclerosis in mice.
This project investigates a pain signaling pathway activated by radiation in patients with head and neck cancer.
This project examines the different cellular populations in fat tissue to understand how aging and obesity affect health.
This project studies a human DNA mutation and a protein that binds to it to explain why some people develop pulmonary hypertension.
This project builds porcine models of pancreatic cancer for developing therapeutics and devices to detect, image and treat tumors.
This project develops and tests a smartphone tool that helps women in informal settlements stay safe from intimate partner violence and extreme weather.
This project studies how a poorly working ubiquitin proteasome system leads to abdominal aortic aneurysm.
